selection.name: South African National Plant Checklist
selection.use: Canonical names, accepted/synonym relationships, province-level distribution, establishment status.
selection.limitation: Threat status is sparsely populated; use SANBI Red List separately for conservation decisions.

selection.name: Botanical Database of Southern Africa (BODATSA): Botanical Collections
selection.license: CC BY 4.0 on GBIF/IPT; POSA separately displays CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
selection.use: Evidence that a taxon has verified herbarium records in the Western Cape; occurrence density and geography.
selection.limitation: Occurrence is not garden suitability. The archive contains specimens, not structured light/water/soil or mature-spread traits.

selection.name: A list of alien taxa for South Africa
selection.use: Alien/native status, confidence, establishment, pathways, impacts, treatment and regulatory-listing fields.
selection.limitation: Research checklist fields do not replace the operative NEMBA notices; legal exclusions must cite the gazetted list.

selection.name: Foliar Trait and Spectroscopy Data, Greater Cape Floristic Region, South Africa
selection.license: Openly shared without restriction on ORNL DAAC; companion repository is GPL-3.0
selection.use: Maximum height, growth form, life history, flowering, flammability and measured height/canopy axes for GCFR plants.
selection.limitation: Field measurements are not guaranteed horticultural mature dimensions. Use them with a source label and confidence, not as exact nursery specifications.

selection.name: SANBI National Vegetation Map 2018 — Western Cape clip
selection.license: Source/copyright SANBI; BGIS datasets use CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
selection.use: Map a garden location to vegetation type, biome and bioregion.
selection.limitation: This is the public Western Cape 2018 clip. SANBI's 2024 national vegetation map is newer and should replace it when a suitable full download/hosting strategy is chosen.

selection.name: NEMBA Alien and Invasive Species List (Government Notice 1003)
selection.use: Authoritative legal reference for prohibited/restricted invasive-species handling.
selection.limitation: PDF legal text is retained as evidence. A reviewed, versioned machine-readable legal table should be created before enforcing rules in production.

deferred.name: PlantZAfrica
deferred.reason: Excellent curated horticultural profiles, but no official bulk export or clear reusable bulk-data licence was found. Use for reviewed enrichment only.

deferred.name: SANBI Red List
deferred.reason: Use as the conservation-status authority, but no bulk download was found during this pass. Do not infer threat status from occurrence frequency.

deferred.name: Soil, light and irrigation tolerances
deferred.reason: No comprehensive authoritative South African plant-level dataset was found. These fields require curated horticultural enrichment and explicit confidence/provenance.
